name: Tachibana Rei
source:
She is a cool type with a serious streak and leadership skills, and is the president of the student council at her school. 

However, when she encounters something unexpected or out of the ordinary (such as the main character's ability), she loses her cool and is still mentally young.

[From [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/tun_fuwa/index.htm]official site[/url]]
